# Redundancy: what am I owed, and how much is tax-free?

> Free UK statutory redundancy pay calculator: enter your dates and weekly pay to see your redundancy pay, the weekly cap, your minimum notice and how much of it is tax-free. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
